level_rationale: L5 (Trust): all 14 digest vectors and all 31 registry skill digests; every security corpus case, including evasions, and all 31 registry skill rule sets identical to the Python implementation; lockfile verification agreeing on a deliberately tampered install, including the exit-code taxonomy; and every signature, advisory and attestation vector of agtmls-spec chapters 9 to 11, verdicts with their exit codes and attestations byte for byte. Verified by agtmls-spec/conformance/run.py, which compares the two implementations to each other rather than only to expected values.

not_implemented.install: agtmls-core verifies an install but does not create one. Installation remains the Python implementation's responsibility; the lockfile is the interop boundary.
